name: OMK Node AtomS3 Lite reviewed binary SBOM
documentComment: Reviewed and supplemented inventory, not unmodified esp-idf-sbom output. Inputs: clean build at 9a167edbd13f24b46f342b9ffa865da30ab60cd1, both linker maps, compiler include dependencies, installed source/license texts. Component-directory false positives were removed and runtime and embedded third-party portions added. Retained archive means nonzero-address, nonzero-size input section in the memory-map portion, excluding discarded sections and cross references. Archive hashes describe build inputs; file hashes identify the actual distributed binaries. Complete copyright and license notices are in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md. Build tools and ROM-resident code are excluded.

packages.name: OMK Node AtomS3 Lite prebuilt distribution
packages.licenseComments: OMK has its own root LICENSE; it is not Apache-2.0. Third-party licenses are recorded separately. See ../../LICENSE_AUDIT.md for build provenance and metadata-only comparison with the distributed binaries.
